AUXILIARY_PRINT_BDADDR

Auxiliary Interface that is used to print BD address.

TRACE_BDADDR(bd_addr)     trace_string(COMBINE_TRACE_INFO(LOG_TYPE, SUBTYPE_BDADDR, 0, 0), 0, (char *)(bd_addr))

AUXILIARY_PRINT_STRING

Auxiliary Interface that is used to print string.

Auxiliary Interface that is used to print binary string.
